name: fraud-detection-dashboard-monorepo
description: High-performance real-time banking fraud detection system powered by C++17 DSA engine, Node.js API, MongoDB, and React dashboard

scripts.build:cpp: cd FraudDetectionDashboard/fraud-engine && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Iinclude src/main.cpp src/TransactionGenerator.cpp src/FraudInjector.cpp src/FraudDetector.cpp src/TransactionGraph.cpp src/DSU.cpp src/RiskScorer.cpp src/JsonSerializer.cpp src/StreamSimulator.cpp -o fraud_engine.exe
